params.prompt: Compose: the stone Tejaji shrine from the FIRST reference image (same shrine, same idol, same oil lamp, same wrapped red threads) standing on the left of frame at night at a village fair — and beside it, right of frame in profile facing the shrine, the MAN from the second reference and the WOMAN from the third reference performing this gesture: his bare wrist held out, she tying a red sacred thread onto it.
